name: ant-vc
description: ant. for VCs: a proactive chief of staff for venture capital teams at every level. It connects your email, calendar, meeting notes and CRM, builds a private map of your people, deals, portfolio and LPs, then brings you a morning brief, meeting prep, post-meeting follow-ups, pipeline nudges, inbound triage, deal memo drafts and portfolio and LP alerts before you ask. Nothing is sent or deleted without your tap.
